introduction.definition: An agitated reactor is a vessel with a motor-driven agitator in which reactions are carried out. Impellers mix the contents, baffles turn swirl into top-to-bottom circulation, and a jacket and/or internal coil add or remove heat to keep the reaction at the right temperature.

classification.type: Continuous stirred-tank / batch reactor, jacketed, baffled, dual impeller

introduction.summary: An agitated (stirred-tank) reactor mixes reactants in a vessel with a motor-driven agitator. Wall baffles stop the liquid simply swirling and turn the flow into top-to-bottom circulation. A jacket and/or internal coil add or remove the reaction heat. It is the workhorse of batch chemical and pharmaceutical production.

video_tutorials.title: Agitated Reactor — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Agitated Reactor.
An agitated reactor is a vessel with a motor-driven agitator in which reactions are carried out.
Impellers mix the contents, baffles turn swirl into top-to-bottom circulation, and a jacket and/or internal coil add or remove heat to keep the reaction at the right temperature.
Typical applications include batch chemical and pharmaceutical synthesis; polymerisation; fermentation (bioreactors); neutralisation and crystallisation.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Agitator: Shaft & Two Pitched-Blade Turbines.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Agitated Reactor works.
The drive turns the agitator shaft.
Pitched-blade impellers pump liquid down; it rises at the walls.
Baffles stop the liquid swirling round as a whole.
The jacket and coil remove the reaction heat.
Reactants enter through the top nozzles; product leaves at the bottom.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Agitated Reactor.
Check seal, agitator current, temperatures.
Inspect impellers, baffles, coil.
Seal and gearbox overhaul.
Watch for runaway temperature: temperature/pressure rise. Common cause: cooling failure, overcharge.
Watch for seal leakage: leak at agitator. Common cause: seal wear, shaft run-out.
Watch for poor mixing: hot spots, off-spec. Common cause: wrong speed/impeller, missing baffles.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
